Sunday Split

Wordle for fantasy football. Five real matchups. One daily challenge.

YOU KNOW BALL? PROVE IT.

What is Sunday Split?

A free daily fantasy football guessing game. Two real starting lineups. One completed matchup. Pick who won, then watch the points come in. Make five separate calls for a daily score out of five.

Five matchups. Your calls.

Everyone gets the same Daily Five, refreshed at midnight Eastern. Compare starters, scoring, NFL opponents, and recent form before locking in each pick.

How it works

Read the lineup. Not the score.

Correct calls earn two points without a hint, or one with a paired-position hint. Your headline result is winners picked out of five. Keep playing in Endless, or find more modes under More.

Scoring & modes

Real completed matchups from 10-team Sleeper leagues. Recent-form clues use games played before the matchup, never its hidden score. About the data
